cohort: The study included 28 patients with a twin pregnancy and mid-trimester bulging membranes admitted to a tertiary hospital from January 2012 to September 2023.
finding: Patients with twin pregnancies and mid-trimester bulging membranes without intra-amniotic inflammation (IAI) who underwent emergency cerclage experienced significantly longer latency to delivery, higher gestational age at delivery, and lower incidence of preterm birth and perinatal death compared to those with IAI.
gest_age: Patients were included with mid-trimester bulging membranes, and gestational age at delivery was an outcome, ranging from 23 +/- 4 weeks to 34 +/- 3 weeks depending on IL-6 or CRP levels.
